Counting Lattices: An Introduction

Abstract

An elementary introduction to lattice counting for readers new to the area.

1. Introduction

We assume no background beyond elementary set theory.

2. Definitions

A lattice is a poset with all binary meets and joins.

3. Conclusions

The reader should now be able to follow the enumeration literature.

References

  1. P. Alexandroff. Diskrete Räume. Mat. Sbornik, 2:501-519, 1937.
  2. R. Stanley. On the number of open sets of finite topologies. J. Combin. Theory, 10(1):74-79, 1971. doi:10.1016/S0021-9800(71)80011-5
